notes.title: May Update
notes.notes:
Checkout the backstory of the Garhiem Dragon.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fgF7LJoaa2Q

Our team has been hard at work polishing the game. We've made 500+ improvements, including:


 Huge perf improvements
 Better lighting for every level
 Nicer looking UI and effects
 Extensive balance improvements
 Implementing more top tier talents

Our new website has been released
- Items page
- Levels page
- New homepage

Gameplay Improvements
- Upgraded to the PUN2 networking engine for improved network synchronization.
- New HUD design.
- Fixed a bug where seeking objects like Soul Blast would get lost. 
- Balance changes to all 9 dragons. 
- Towers are better at defending themselves, striking back at players who hit them from outside their normal range.
- Turned down basic attack sounds.
- Camera shakes when you take a heavy hit.
- UI cleaner and more polished in the character selection scene.
- High Peak Arena has more sheep healing stations.
- new 3 icons for top level talents.
